head: One UI 9.5 may let Galaxy phones record WhatsApp, Telegram and Meet calls
dek: An early One UI 9.5 build has a "Record calls in other apps" option in Samsung's Phone app, with a switch each for WhatsApp, Telegram and Google Meet, SamMobile found.
details: The screen warns that the other people won't hear a recording notice, and that you're responsible for telling them. It may only come to some countries because of call recording laws. Samsung hasn't announced One UI 9.5.
where: Galaxy phones, One UI 9.5, not announced
means: Your Galaxy's call recorder may work for app calls too, not just regular phone calls.
todo: Nothing to do yet; if it arrives, check your country's rules and tell people before you record.
